answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the basalt graph. Re-attestations are stored in forge and mirror lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1266 impostors cost 670 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
